classification.analysis: This is Google's official index of Model Context Protocol servers and guidance for using them, listing both Google-managed remote MCP endpoints (BigQuery, Cloud SQL, GKE, Spanner, and more) and open-source MCP servers (Workspace, Firebase, Cloud Run, gcloud CLI, security tooling) that can run locally or be deployed to Cloud Run/GKE. It includes two runnable example agents (a bakery demand-planning agent and a migrated full-stack app) plus links to deployment guides and codelabs. It's a reference/landing repo for developers wiring AI agents such as Gemini CLI or ADK into Google Cloud services via MCP, not itself a server implementation.
